# Vendored W3C WoT schema

`tm-json-schema-v1.1.json` is the JSON Schema for Thing Models published with the W3C
Web of Things (WoT) Thing Description 1.1 Recommendation, vendored unmodified so the test
that validates the platform's Thing Model export runs without network access.

- Source: <https://www.w3.org/2022/wot/tm-schema/v1.1> (schema `version`
  `1.1-12-March-2025`), retrieved 2026-10-13.
- SHA-256: `6912708a0fa9966b51ae75f91951cf48a202d873023b8cba1b53ba4af51e92d3`
- Maintained in <https://github.com/w3c/wot-thing-description> (`validation/`).
- License: [W3C Software and Document License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license-2023/).
  Copyright © World Wide Web Consortium. The file is redistributed unchanged.

To update it, fetch the URL above, replace the file, and update the version, date and
digest here.
